# Fetch all liked songs (paginate with page_limit=20)
liked_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    # If failure, break or handle
    if isinstance(page, dict) and 'message' in page:
        print("Error fetching liked songs:", page)
        break
    if not page:
        break
    for song in page:
        liked_song_ids.add(song['song_id'])
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Liked song IDs:", liked_song_ids)
